links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of AI versus two experienced pathologists on same clinical cases, histopathology as gold standard
links.effect: BALFilter Reader sensitivity 66.7% ± 16.7%, specificity 100.0% ± 0.0%, accuracy 75.0% ± 12.5% in ~2 min, versus pathologists' sensitivity 61.1%, specificity 16.7%, accuracy 50.0% in 10-30 min.
links.quote: The overall diagnosis performance (~2 min) with sensitivity@66.7% ± 16.7%, specificity@100.0% ± 0.0% and accuracy@75.0% ± 12.5% was superior to that from two experienced pathologists (10-30 min) with sensitivity@61.1%, specificity@16.7% and accuracy@50.0%, with the histopathological result as the gold standard.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an enhanced YOLOv5 object detection algorithm (BALFilter Reader) to identify rare tumor cells in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, comparing its diagnostic performance against two pathologists in a retrospective test set.
